lots.title: Royal Salute 'The Eternal Reserve'
lots.seen_in_photos: Black ceramic flagon with gold 8 logo, gilt-grey metal cap, neck label with signature (Colin Scott), numbered strip label on neck and on box (003A16), back label, brown box.
lots.text_read: ROYAL SALUTE THE ETERNAL RESERVE; Original 88 casks form the heart of this blend; Blended Scotch Whisky; neck label 003A16 signed Colin Scott; back: The Royal Gun Salutes Tower of London, 70cl e 700ml, 40%vol 40 GL 40% alc/vol, Product of Scotland, Blended and bottled by Chivas Brothers Ltd, Distillers, Keith AB55 5BS; QR code.
lots.not_in_title: Numbered/signed bottle (003A16), box present (title has no GB), blend of 88 casks. Limited Eternal Reserve release (a Royal Salute travel-retail style edition). Minor.
lots.title_errors: Title omits (GB) though a box is shown
lots.reason: Accurately named modern release; only the box and bottle number are not stated.
lots.condition: Neck label slightly lifted/torn near the signature strip; box appears fine; no fill assessment possible.
lots.unreadable: Fill level not assessable (opaque ceramic); fine print on some neck labels too small

lots.title: Royal Salute 21 Year Old Emerald Flagon, 43% ABV, Circa 1980's
lots.seen_in_photos: Older green ceramic flagon, pewter-look cap and chain-pattern neck seal strip (torn), paper duty-type strip over cap hand-inked, burgundy tassel and cardboard hang tag 21 YEAR OLD, relief crest, oval 21 Years Old label, back label with castellated border, lower importer label. No box visible in the photos despite (GB).
lots.text_read: Hang tag ROYAL SALUTE 21 YEAR OLD Blended Scotch Whisky; front label Royal Salute 21 Years Old Blended Scotch Whisky; base label: Product of Scotland, Blended and bottled by Chivas Brothers Ltd, 700 ml, Distillers, Aberdeen, Est. 1801, 43% alc/vol, Scotland; back: By an ancient custom, originating in the Royal Navy, a salute of twenty-one guns is the prerogative of the Reigning Sovereign. Royal Salute Whisky, created to celebrate the Coronation of her Majesty, Queen Elizabeth, symbolizes this homage; Imported by Seagram Australia Pty. Ltd., 32 Jasmine Street, Botany N.S.W.; label numbers 2506470, 2506931; handwritten LC7 0267 on cap strip.
lots.not_in_title: Seagram Australia import label (Botany NSW), Chivas Brothers Aberdeen address, hand-inked cap strip number (LC7 0267), original tassel and hang tag; 700 ml with 43% (older style, pre-70cl/40% era). The older Aberdeen/Est.1801 design fits the 1970s-80s.
lots.title_errors: Title says (GB) but no box seen in the photos; otherwise consistent
lots.bottling_era: Estimated 1980s, supported by 43% and 700ml, Aberdeen address, Seagram Australia importer label, no barcode, tassel and tag.
lots.reason: Webb's already dates it to the 1980s and 43%; the Australian importer label, tag and tassel are extras collectors like but it is a common older Royal Salute flagon, so only modest hidden value.
lots.condition: Back label has a small chip at lower left corner; neck foil strip torn; paper strip across cap stained; cork/cap likely aged; fill level cannot be judged through opaque ceramic. If the box is not included, that is a minus.
lots.unreadable: Fill level not assessable (opaque ceramic); fine print on some neck labels too small
